_comment: CP-PLAT-M10.1 performance-regression baseline. Means (ns) from a quick-pass Criterion run (--warm-up-time 0.2 --measurement-time 1.0 --sample-size 20) of the hot paths: Value::parse, DC op-point, and Backward-Euler transient. Numbers are captured ON the ubuntu-latest CI runner (NOT a dev laptop) so the gate compares like-for-like — regenerate them from a CI run, not locally, with `python3 -I benches/ci/compare.py --update`. The threshold is a GROSS-regression guard (it catches algorithmic 1.5x+ blowups, not jitter): GitHub-hosted runners are shared and noisy, and the sub-10us op_point bench alone swings well past 25% run-to-run, so a tighter number would only flake.
